title: Banerjee Residence | Teal Study Bedroom
subtitle: Compact Bedroom with Built-In Study & Wardrobe
description: A 150 sq.ft. bedroom in Sukdebpur that fits a queen bed, full-height wardrobe and built-in study into a compact footprint, using a soft teal, white and light oak palette, a wall-to-wall upholstered headboard and layered cove lighting to keep the room calm and open.
body:
Designed for Prasun Banerjee in Sukdebpur, this 150 sq.ft. bedroom shows how a compact room can hold sleeping, storage and study without feeling crowded.

A wall-to-wall teal upholstered headboard anchors the bed wall, framed by white panels with concealed LED strips. Opposite, a single built-in unit combines a full-height wardrobe, a study niche with a floating desk and lit shelving, and a matching door, so storage and work space take up one wall instead of three.

A soft palette of teal, white and light oak, together with a cove-lit ceiling and marble-look flooring, keeps the room bright, calm and visually larger than its footprint.
features.0.title: A Wall-to-Wall Headboard
features.0.text: A channel-stitched teal headboard runs the full width of the bed wall, with integrated switch panels on each side and floating white side tables below. Above it, white wall panels with concealed vertical and horizontal LED strips create a soft, glowing backdrop.
features.1.title: Wardrobe & Study in One Wall
features.1.text: A full-height wardrobe with teal-and-white banded shutters and long vertical handles flows into a built-in study niche with a floating desk, lit book shelf and overhead storage. The door is finished to match, so the whole wall reads as a single, ordered unit.
features.2.title: Light, Warmth & Space
features.2.text: Light oak frames around the windows and study bring warmth to the cool teal palette, while a recessed ceiling with cove lighting, downlights and white marble-look flooring keep the compact room bright and visually larger.
highlights.0.title: Built-In Study
highlights.0.text: A floating desk with lit shelving and overhead storage, integrated into the wardrobe wall.
highlights.1.title: Full-Height Storage
highlights.1.text: Floor-to-ceiling wardrobe with loft units makes full use of the wall height.
highlights.2.title: Wall-to-Wall Headboard
highlights.2.text: Upholstered teal panels with integrated switches span the entire bed wall.
highlights.3.title: Layered Lighting
highlights.3.text: Cove lighting, recessed downlights and concealed LED strips in the wall panels.
highlights.4.title: Efficient 150 sq.ft. Plan
highlights.4.text: Bed, wardrobe and study fitted into a compact room without crowding it.
